summary: Added goal worker configuration support: introduced CliWorkerId/EnabledWorkers and GoalConfig.enabledWorkers in src/config/types.goal.ts, added goal.enabledWorkers schema validation in src/config/zod-schema.ts as an optional non-empty array of codex/claude_code, and added resolveEnabledWorkers(config?) in src/goal/backend-types.ts with default ["codex", "claude_code"] when unset. Verified with pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, pnpm lint, and node scripts/run-node.mjs goal --help.
